steps.do: Update each deliverable's status from its handoffs and evidence, and mark any that passed its due date.
Write every scope change the client asked for as a change request with its price and date impact, and bring each to the founder before work on it starts.

Compare each engagement's budget with the effort spent, flag any forecast margin under 35% and any week where delivery took more than half of the founder's time, and propose the order of work to the product lead.
For each deliverable ready to go to the client, prepare the message and the evidence that it meets its acceptance test, for the founder to send.

For each engagement whose deliverables are all accepted, write the close review (what went well, why anything overran, what can be reused) and close it; on the third delivery of the same request, propose a fixed-scope offer.

done_criteria.check: Is every scope change on an active engagement either approved or open as a decision for the founder, with no work started on an unapproved one?
